baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from أَوْجَسَ and خِيفَةً through لَا تَخَفْ to بَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَامٍ عَلِيمٍ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A barely registered inward alarm becomes explicit, is countered by direct speech, and is displaced by a joy-opening report whose object joins youth to knowledge. The ayah turns anticipated harm into an intelligible future without denying that fear first arose.

activation_trace.role: The inward arrival of fear or a thought supplies the concealed alarm that initiates the pivot.
Alarm that anticipates harm supplies both the state named and the expectation canceled by the prohibition.
Uttered speech makes the intervention audible and socially operative rather than leaving fear inside.
A report that opens the skin with joy supplies the positive force that replaces anticipated injury.
Youth gives the announced future a living, early-stage human form.
Knowledge as disclosure makes the future not merely biological but perceptive and intelligible.

changed_reading.before: He feels fear, receives reassurance, and is then told of a knowledgeable boy.
changed_reading.after: The visitors' utterance performs an affective and temporal transfer: concealed expectation of harm is answered by a disclosed future embodied in a young knower.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The movement from inward sensing to visible fear, skin-opening news, and the qualifier عَلِيم.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah traverses an inside-out path: a hidden signal is registered inwardly, fear becomes readable, speech addresses it, and the announcement opens onto a future marked by legibility. Emotional disclosure and cognitive disclosure become parallel operations.

activation_trace.role: A hidden sound and the act of listening for it frame Abraham's response as detection of a low-signal disturbance.
Fear becoming outwardly apparent forms the bridge from private sensing to a state the visitors can answer.
The visible skin or surface supplies the bodily boundary across which inward affect becomes manifest.
Joy-opening news converts the exposed surface from an index of fear into an index of promised good.
A distinguishing mark that guides recognition lets the final adjective resonate with legibility as well as cognition.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a private emotion followed by unrelated reassuring information.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages a conversion of hidden disturbance into legible promise: what is sensed within is answered on the surface and projected as a marked, knowable future.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence turns أَوْجَسَ into practical inference. Unknown entrants are met by Abraham's own hidden movement, food is brought close, and eating is solicited; the missing reciprocal act makes their social identity unreadable. Fear is therefore not free-floating panic but a conclusion drawn from a failed hospitality test.

activation_trace.role: Listening for a hidden signal supplies the diagnostic posture by which a subtle anomaly is detected.
Tasting only a little supplies an exploratory sampling image: the host tests the encounter through food without receiving a normal response.
Anticipation of harm is the inference produced when the social test fails.
Nonrecognition supplies the initial uncertainty about who the visitors are.
A hidden sideward movement makes Abraham's hospitality itself discreet and observational.
Bringing the food near removes distance and makes acceptance or refusal immediately legible.
Literal eating supplies the expected reciprocal act whose absence triggers the diagnosis.

structural_cues: The ordered movement is unknown guests in 51:25, discreet provisioning in 51:26, food brought near and an eating question in 51:27, then inward fear in 51:28.
The focus says fear arose مِنْهُمْ, keeping the conclusion attached to the visitors' behavior.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nonrecognition, hidden movement, proximity, eating, and then fear; I infer that refusal or nonparticipation is the arrow from observation to alarm. A live alternative is that unfamiliarity or sudden entry, rather than the meal test, is sufficient.

changed_reading.before: Abraham simply becomes afraid of strange visitors.
changed_reading.after: Abraham samples an opaque social encounter and infers danger when offered proximity and food fail to produce recognizable guest behavior.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later disclosure preserves the accuracy of Abraham's sensitivity while revising its target. These visitors are commissioned around a grave affair, crime, hard projectiles, and assigned harm. لَا تَخَفْ does not prove that no danger was present; it excludes Abraham from danger that is real and directed elsewhere, while the good news positively reallocates his future.

activation_trace.role: The inwardly arriving alarm registers a real threatening capacity before its destination is known.
Expected harm supplies the perception that is corrected by address rather than erased as baseless.
Joy-opening news gives Abraham a positive allotment opposite the visitors' punitive commission.
A grave matter confirms that the encounter carries more than benign hospitality.
Messenger and message supply an authorized mission behind the visitors' presence.
Crime and offense identify the distant recipients toward whom the punitive side of the mission is directed.
Hard stone supplies the mission's concrete capacity to injure.
The imposition of harm supplies directed assignment rather than diffuse menace.

structural_cues: The same speaking group first says not to fear and gives good news, then identifies a destructive commission in 51:31-34.
The focus locates fear as arising from them but leaves its intended target unresolved until the later mission statement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies alarm, reassurance, commission, offenders, stones, and assigned harm; I infer that Abraham senses genuine dangerous capacity but mislocates its target. A live alternative is that his meal-based fear and their later commission are narratively adjacent but causally independent.

changed_reading.before: The reassurance corrects a wholly mistaken fear of harmless visitors.
changed_reading.after: The reassurance calibrates an accurate alarm: the visitors bear real danger, but Abraham is exempted from its target and assigned a life-bearing future instead.

context_deltas.mechanism: The boy's youth and knowledge are announced against explicit old age, incapacity, and blocked fertility. The following appeal to lordly completion, growth, and exact ordering makes the news a reversal of a closed biological horizon rather than an ordinary prediction.

activation_trace.role: First signs and beginnings cast the announcement as the opening edge of a process not yet visible.
Youth embodies the new beginning opposed to the parents' exhausted capacity.
Disclosed knowledge projects the promised life beyond birth toward developed human capacity.
Old age supplies the temporal closure against which youthful futurity is announced.
Infertility supplies the blocked generative channel that the announcement contradicts.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply an agency capable of carrying the announced beginning through.
The non-dominant mapped branch of nourishment and growth sharpens the mechanism as emergence, not merely command.
Exactness and firm ordering keep the reversal from reading as an unbounded fantasy.

structural_cues: The promised young knower in 51:28 is immediately answered by the wife's paired self-descriptions of age and infertility in 51:29.
The reply in 51:30 attributes the statement to her Lord and closes with wisdom and knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies youthful promise, old age, infertility, completion, growth, and exactness; I infer an opening-through-closure mechanism. A live alternative is that the wife's descriptors register surprise only and do not define the promise's causal shape.

changed_reading.before: The visitors add the pleasant information that a boy will be born.
changed_reading.after: The announcement declares a precisely sustained emergence of knowing life at the point where time and the body jointly say that generation is closed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The news does not move the household from fear into uncomplicated calm. Abraham's disturbance begins inwardly, but the wife's response arrives as cry, impact, and face. The announcement is good in direction while remaining physically destabilizing in reception.

activation_trace.role: Fear appearing on a person initiates a bodily register that continues beyond Abraham.
Visible skin and surface make bodily reaction intrinsic to the semantic field of the announcement.
Joy-opening news supplies the positive orientation whose reception can still be forceful and disorganizing.
A cry or piercing sound externalizes what had been inward disturbance.
Collision and forceful striking give the announcement a bodily impact without making its content harmful.
The face supplies the visible surface on which the household's second reaction is registered.

structural_cues: The inward fear and skin-opening announcement of 51:28 are followed without a scene break by the wife's audible and facial response in 51:29.
Different members of the household receive the same encounter through different bodily channels.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible fear, surface-opening news, a cry, a strike, and a face; I infer propagation from verbal announcement to embodied shock. A live alternative is that the wife's movement expresses only disbelief at age and fertility, not an extension of the prior affective pattern.

changed_reading.before: Good news cleanly resolves the fearful episode into joy.
changed_reading.after: Good news reverses the encounter's direction but not its intensity: concealed fear in one hearer becomes audible, visible shock in another.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final qualifier can remain cognitive while also entering a sequence of legibility: the boy is announced with a term whose branch includes a guiding mark; divine knowledge repeats; destructive matter is marked; and an enduring sign is left. The pericope distinguishes a promised future and a punished destination through different modes of designation.

activation_trace.role: First signs make the announcement an anticipatory trace of a future not yet present.
A distinguishing mark that guides recognition gives the promised boy a secondary resonance of legibility.
The repeated mark-and-guidance branch places the announcement within a larger field of discriminating knowledge.
A visible identifying mark supplies explicit designation on the punitive side of the sequence.
An effect remaining after departure supplies temporal persistence to the act of signification.
An evident sign completes the progression from announcement to durable legibility.

structural_cues: The sequence places عَلِيم in 51:28, repeats the same root in 51:30, introduces marked objects in 51:34, and ends by leaving a sign in 51:37.
Life-bearing news and punitive assignment remain opposite outcomes rather than being merged.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies branches of knowledge, marking, retained effect, and visible sign; I infer a shared function of making destinations legible. A live alternative is that عَلِيم is exclusively cognitive and the later marking vocabulary belongs only to punishment.

changed_reading.before: عَلِيم only predicts the boy's intellectual quality.
changed_reading.after: The boy remains knowledgeable but also becomes the first legible trace of a promised future within a passage that repeatedly marks, distinguishes, and leaves signs.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence distinguishes two fears rather than abolishing fear. Security and wholeness characterize those removed from danger, while the retained sign addresses people who fear painful punishment. The focus prohibition therefore recalibrates an immediate, misdirected alarm; it does not suppress the receptive fear by which consequences are read.

activation_trace.role: Expected harm supplies the local fear explicitly prohibited in the encounter.
Settled security identifies the protected condition produced by removal from danger.
Safety and freedom from injury reinforce protection without making all fear meaningless.
A visible sign supplies the object that later fear is capable of reading.
Anticipation of harm returns as a receptive orientation toward consequence rather than panic before the visitors.
Punitive suffering specifies the later fear's warranted object.
Pain gives concrete affective weight to the consequence that the sign warns about.

structural_cues: The focus contains fear twice, first as a noun and then under direct prohibition; 51:37 positively identifies the sign's audience by the same root.
Security and safety intervene in 51:35-36 before fear returns in 51:37 with a specified object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prohibited proximal fear, protected security, a warning sign, and fear of painful punishment; I infer calibration by object and addressee. A live alternative is that the two fear occurrences have no designed contrast beyond ordinary contextual difference.

changed_reading.before: لَا تَخَفْ is a general movement from fear to fearlessness.
changed_reading.after: لَا تَخَفْ removes fear aimed at the visitors from this protected addressee while preserving fear as the capacity to recognize a warranted warning.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the long-duration branch of و ج س is distant from the focus form, yet it remains anchored in أَوْجَسَ and coheres with first signs, youth, and mature knowledge. Render it only as a temporal resonance, not as a replacement lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَوْجَسَ, بَشَّرُوهُ, غُلَامٍ, and عَلِيمٍ jointly span hidden present, beginning, youth, and developed capacity.

activation_trace.role: Long duration supplies a remote temporal horizon behind the momentary inward event.
First signs supply the earliest visible edge of the promised process.
Youth places the announced person at an early life stage.
Knowledge projects the announcement toward developed capacity later in the life course.

changed_reading.before: The ayah moves through an immediate emotional exchange.
changed_reading.after: The immediate exchange compresses a long horizon: the first announcement already holds youth and eventual knowingness together.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because the text does not state that a declined meal is exchanged for a child. It remains anchored in the focus food-tasting branch, the announcement, the boy, and the ordered calf-eating-infertility sequence. Render it as material analogy or transposition, never as explicit causation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The food-tasting branch of أَوْجَسَ and the movement to بَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَامٍ connect the interrupted meal to a different kind of embodied abundance.

activation_trace.role: Tasting food little by little keeps the focus verb materially attached to the interrupted meal.
Joy-opening news supplies the nonmaterial return that follows the unconsumed offering.
Youth turns abundance from prepared flesh toward new human life.
The calf supplies the concrete body offered for nourishment.
Fatness supplies material plenitude at the table.
Eating supplies the expected conversion of offered abundance that does not occur.
Infertility supplies the blocked bodily abundance that the child announcement opens.

changed_reading.before: The rejected meal and the child announcement are consecutive but unrelated events.
changed_reading.after: The sequence resonates as a transposition of abundance: food does not pass into the guests, while promised life opens through a body described as unable to generate.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading depends on the non-dominant ق ل ل mapping of ق و ل and is therefore form-distant. It remains packet-licensed and anchored in قَالُوا, fear, the following cry, and facial strike. Render it as an acoustic-affective echo in the speech event, not as the lexical meaning of قَالُوا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَالُوا لَا تَخَفْ places utterance directly against fear before the next ayah externalizes disturbance in sound and impact.

activation_trace.role: Fear expecting harm supplies the affective pressure to which the utterance responds.
The split-root image of trembling from fright lets the speech event echo the disturbance it verbally opposes.
Agitated movement supplies a vibratory register for speech acting upon fear.
The following cry carries disturbance outward as audible vibration.
Forceful collision converts the acoustic-affective disturbance into bodily impact.

changed_reading.before: Calming speech ends Abraham's disturbance, after which his wife's reaction is separate.
changed_reading.after: The reassurance acts as a counter-tremor: it steadies one hearer semantically while the encounter's disturbance continues through another hearer's cry and gesture.

strongest_changes: Fear becomes an abductive reading of failed hospitality reciprocity rather than undifferentiated stranger anxiety.
The later punitive mission shows that Abraham sensed real dangerous capacity but mistook its target; reassurance exempts and reallocates rather than declaring the visitors harmless.
The child announcement opens a precisely sustained future where old age and infertility present generation as closed.
The final return of fear distinguishes misdirected proximal alarm from receptive fear of a warranted consequence.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supports several simultaneous conversions without requiring a single final interpretation: hidden signal into social diagnosis, real danger into redirected danger, fear into promised futurity, inward affect into bodily display, and knowledge into a wider but exploratory network of marks and signs.
remaining_uncertainties: The food-tasting branch of و ج س may be a live diagnostic echo or only a form-distant lexical accident.
The mark branch of ع ل م may materially activate the later sign sequence, while the ordinary cognitive reading remains fully live.
The non-dominant ق ل ل mapping can support a contained tremor resonance but should not control the reading of قَالُوا.
The relation between declined nourishment and promised generation is analogical; the packet does not establish an exchange or causal transfer.
